mapper.select: SELECT s.*,u.status AS user_status,u.auth_version AS current_auth_version FROM t_session s JOIN t_user u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash=#{hash} AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.update: UPDATE t_session SET revoked_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash=#{hash}
UPDATE t_session SET csrf_hash=#{csrf} WHERE token_hash=#{hash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
